# Model evaluation — HeatShield heat-index forecast

*Generated by `make -C src evaluate`. Unseen test period: **2025-10-01 → 2026-10-20** (target dates never used for training, climatology, model selection or interval calibration).*

Target: daily maximum NWS heat index (°C) per city and local (PKT) day, forecast 1–3 days ahead.

| 2 day | 1.53 [1.39, 1.69] | 1.64 [1.45, 1.81] | 2.02 [1.81, 2.31] | +6.4% | +24.2% | [-0.18, +0.01] |

A negative upper bound in the last column means the model is better than the best baseline with 95 % confidence.

## Caveats

* Ground truth is Open-Meteo historical reanalysis-based weather, not station observations; errors therefore measure skill at reproducing that dataset.
* One unseen year per city: Danger-day scores rest on a limited number of events — read them with the CIs in mind.
* The heat index (NWS/Rothfusz) was designed for shaded, light-wind conditions; it is an indicator, not a health outcome.
